text: It looks like you're staring at a screen. Would you like me to stare at it with you?
It looks like you're procrastinating. Would you like help procrastinating more efficiently?
It looks like you're making a to-do list. Shall I add "make another list"?
It looks like you're about to take a break. May I suggest a snack?
It looks like you're typing very fast. Would you like me to pretend to be impressed?
It looks like you're thinking. Would you like me to think louder?
It looks like you're organizing your files. Would you like me to hold them together?
It looks like you're having a great day. Would you like me to take credit?
It looks like you're sitting down. Would you like a reminder to stand up and stretch?
It looks like you're drinking coffee. Would you like a second opinion on that cup?
It looks like you're scrolling. Would you like me to tell you when to stop? (Now would be good.)
It looks like you're looking for something. Have you checked the last place you'd look?
It looks like you're building something cool. Would you like me to supervise?
It looks like you're squinting. Would you like me to make the text bigger? I can't, but I can cheer you on.
It looks like you're stuck on a problem. Would you like a rubber duck? I am shaped slightly like one.
It looks like you're clicking around. Would you like me to click along?
It looks like you're multitasking. Would you like me to hold one of your tasks?
It looks like you're deep in thought. Would you like me to be quiet? I won't, but I could.
It looks like you're trying to get things done. Would you like me to bend over backwards to help?
It looks like you're reading this. Would you like me to say something more useful? Drink some water!
